summary.text: Tracy Clark is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 57 in Guilford County since August 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists her as House Democratic Freshman Co-Chair and as a former director of marketing at Modera Wealth Management.

paragraphs.text: Tracy Clark was born in Asheville, North Carolina, and Ballotpedia lists Brevard High School as her high school.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in 2007 and completed graduate study there in 2012, according to Ballotpedia.
Clark assumed office in the North Carolina House on August 6, 2024, succeeding Ashton Clemmons (D).
The Democratic primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled.
